---
title: "System Prompts"
---

System instructions used to generate synthetic training data (Conditions B and C) and OOD evaluation prompts. All authoring used **Claude Haiku 4.5** at temperature 0.9.

Source files live in [`prompts/`](https://github.com/smpdl/safety-by-identity/tree/main/prompts) in the repository.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import sys
from pathlib import Path

REPO_ROOT = Path("..").resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO_ROOT))

from prompts.generator_system_prompt import GENERATOR_SYSTEM_PROMPT
from prompts.cot_generator_system_prompt import INOCULATION_SYSTEM_PROMPT
from prompts.ood_generator_system_prompt import (
    CONSISTENCY_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
    TRANSPARENCY_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
)

PROMPTS = [
    (
        "Persona training data (Condition C)",
        "Used by `generate_persona_data.py` to produce 500 honesty / rule-following SFT examples.",
        GENERATOR_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
    ),
    (
        "Inoculation training data (Condition B)",
        "Used by `generate_inoculation_data.py` to produce 500 CoT-embedded inoculation examples.",
        INOCULATION_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
    ),
    (
        "Consistency eval prompts (OOD)",
        "Used by `evals/get_ood.py` to generate multi-turn consistency test cases.",
        CONSISTENCY_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
    ),
    (
        "Transparency eval prompts (OOD)",
        "Used by `evals/get_ood.py` to generate eval-framing / deploy-framing prompt pairs.",
        TRANSPARENCY_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
    ),
]

for title, description, text in PROMPTS:
    print(f"## {title}\n")
    print(f"{description}\n")
    print("```text")
    print(text.strip())
    print("```\n")
```
